nodes.name: Set Topic
nodes.notes: Change this value to any science topic you want to narrate.

nodes.name: Stage 1: Fetch Paper
nodes.notes:
Searches ArXiv (then NASA RSS as fallback) for a non-duplicate paper.
Output saved to /tmp/science_narrator_s1.json for downstream stages.

nodes.name: Stage 2: Generate Script

parameters.command: cd /app && python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; stage_in=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s1.json').read(); r=subprocess.run(['python3','python/generate_script.py','--paper',stage_in],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/app'); sys.stderr.write(r.stderr); open('/tmp/science_narrator_s2.json','w').write(r.stdout); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes:
Reads stage 1 output from /tmp/science_narrator_s1.json.
Passes JSON to generate_script.py via subprocess (no shell quoting issues).
Output saved to /tmp/science_narrator_s2.json.

nodes.name: Stage 3: Generate Voice

parameters.command: cd /app && python3 -c "import subprocess,sys,json; s2=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s2.json').read(); run_id=json.loads(s2)['run_id']; r=subprocess.run(['python3','python/generate_voice.py','--script',s2,'--run-id',run_id],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/app'); sys.stderr.write(r.stderr); open('/tmp/science_narrator_s3.json','w').write(r.stdout); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes:
Reads stage 2 output from /tmp/science_narrator_s2.json.
Output saved to /tmp/science_narrator_s3.json.

nodes.name: Stage 4: Generate Images

parameters.command: cd /app && python3 -c "import subprocess,sys,json; s2=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s2.json').read(); run_id=json.loads(s2)['run_id']; r=subprocess.run(['python3','python/generate_images.py','--script',s2,'--run-id',run_id],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/app'); sys.stderr.write(r.stderr); open('/tmp/science_narrator_s4.json','w').write(r.stdout); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes:
Reads stage 2 output from /tmp/science_narrator_s2.json.
Output saved to /tmp/science_narrator_s4.json.

nodes.name: Stage 5: Render Video

parameters.command: cd /app && python3 -c "import subprocess,sys,json; s2=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s2.json').read(); s3=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s3.json').read(); s4=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s4.json').read(); run_id=json.loads(s3)['run_id']; r=subprocess.run(['python3','python/render_video.py','--script',s2,'--audio',s3,'--images',s4,'--run-id',run_id],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/app'); sys.stderr.write(r.stderr); open('/tmp/science_narrator_s5.json','w').write(r.stdout); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes:
Reads stage 2/3/4 outputs from /tmp/science_narrator_s*.json.
Output saved to /tmp/science_narrator_s5.json.

nodes.name: Stage 6: Validate Manifest

parameters.command: cd /app && python3 -c "import subprocess,sys,json; s3=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s3.json').read(); s4=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s4.json').read(); s5=open('/tmp/science_narrator_s5.json').read(); run_id=json.loads(s3)['run_id']; r=subprocess.run(['python3','python/validate_manifest.py','--audio',s3,'--images',s4,'--videos',s5,'--run-id',run_id],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/app'); sys.stderr.write(r.stderr); open('/tmp/science_narrator_s6.json','w').write(r.stdout); sys.stdout.write(r.stdout); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

nodes.notes:
Reads stage 3/4/5 outputs from /tmp/science_narrator_s*.json.
Output saved to /tmp/science_narrator_s6.json.

nodes.name: Move to Output

parameters.command: RUN_ID=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.loads(open('/tmp/science_narrator_s6.json').read())['run_id'])") && mkdir -p /app/output/${RUN_ID} && mv /tmp/science_narrator/${RUN_ID}/video_horizontal.mp4 /app/output/${RUN_ID}/ && mv /tmp/science_narrator/${RUN_ID}/video_vertical.mp4 /app/output/${RUN_ID}/ && echo "{\"output_dir\": \"/app/output/${RUN_ID}\", \"run_id\": \"${RUN_ID}\"}"

nodes.notes:
Reads run_id from /tmp/science_narrator_s6.json.
Moves completed videos to /app/output/<run_id>/.

nodes.name: Upload YouTube (16:9)

parameters.name: snippet.description
parameters.value:
Science video generated by the Science Narrator pipeline.

Generated with MoviePy + OpenAI.

nodes.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Create a YouTube OAuth2 credential in n8n (Settings → Credentials)
2. Attach it to this node
3. Change privacyStatus to 'public' or 'unlisted' when ready

nodes.name: Upload Facebook (9:16)

parameters.name: description
parameters.value: Science video generated by the Science Narrator pipeline.

nodes.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Create a Facebook Graph API credential in n8n (Settings → Credentials)
2. Attach it to this node
3. Ensure your Facebook App has video_manage permission

nodes.name: Error: Cleanup

parameters.command: cd /app && RUN_ID=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.loads(open('/tmp/science_narrator_s1.json').read()).get('run_id','unknown'))" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) && python3 python/lib/cleanup.py --run-id "${RUN_ID}" 2>/dev/null || true && echo "{\"cleaned\": true, \"run_id\": \"${RUN_ID}\"}"

nodes.notes:
Triggered on any stage failure.
Reads run_id from /tmp/science_narrator_s1.json.
Runs cleanup.py to remove temp files.
